## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this pull request and the problem it solves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] New skill addition (`skills/<skill-name>`)
- [ ] Rule or documentation update (`RULES.md`, `README.md`)
- [ ] CLI installer improvement (`bin/cli.js`, `install.sh`, `install.ps1`)
- [ ] Bug fix

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] The skill includes valid YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`).
- [ ] All referenced files and subfolders exist within the repository.
- [ ] No emojis or decorative unicode symbols are present in code or copy.
- [ ] Commit messages conform to conventional semantic commit standards.
- [ ] CLI commands run properly if modified.
